scientific_question: Did v186.1 fail because the frozen DCT12 plus reported-ray Plucker feature map destroyed detector-potential information, or because one shared cross-geometry linear fit could not approximate the geometry-local inverse action?
role: post-open mechanism-attribution diagnostic on exactly the same four already-open p=22kw_size=01 frames; it is not predictor training, a complete-trajectory gate, a resource benchmark, fresh generalization, or real BOST
physical_hypothesis: For a fixed reported geometry, detector-potential features generated by affine-coordinate basis responses form a reduced measurement matrix. Its fixed-threshold Moore-Penrose inverse tests whether the frozen feature map itself preserves the observable affine coordinates without imposing v186.1's shared cross-geometry regression constraint.
physical_distinction: v187 keeps the v186.1 potential integration, DCT12 modes, Plucker pooling, affine field basis, sensor arms, K0/K1 refinement, metrics, and accuracy gates unchanged. It removes the shared fit covariance and one global weight matrix, replacing them with one exact geometry-local pseudoinverse of each already-sealed response-feature matrix. No feature, rank threshold, ridge, damping, fallback, candidate search, or accuracy threshold is tuned.

data_isolation.fit_source: inherit the sealed v186.1 affine center, 1009-row basis, and 26 fit-only response-feature matrices; no fit field is reopened and no model is refit
data_isolation.heldout_source: inherit the sealed v186.1 heldout primary features for p=22kw_size=01 frame indices 0,25,75,100 and independently reconstruct only the frozen physical K1 and final scoring chain
heldout_truth_forbidden_from: feature map, response matrices, SVD threshold, retained rank, coordinates, initial field, fallback, stopping, and decision
any setup-specific pseudoinverse or candidate parameter
heldout_truth_allowed_only_for: synthetic observation reconstruction through the frozen forward operator
final field and gradient scoring after observation-only K0 candidates are sealed

primary.name: geometry_local_plucker_dct12_pseudoinverse
primary.response_matrix: for each sensor arm and calibration, H has shape 1009x1144 and is exactly the sealed v186.1 primary response-feature matrix; a coordinate row a produces feature row aH
primary.observation_feature: exactly the sealed v186.1 deployment-visible 1144-vector for each observation
primary.formal_inverse: thin scipy.linalg.svd of H with LAPACK gesdd; retain singular values s_i >= s_0*sqrt(float64 epsilon)
primary.independent_inverse: thin scipy.linalg.svd of independently sealed H with LAPACK gesvd and the identical threshold
primary.coordinate: a=(f V_r^T / s_r) U_r^T for H=U diag(s) V^T

blocking_references.v186_1_shared_linear: inherit the independently validated negative shared-linear K0/K1 result without retuning
blocking_references.v185_dense_potential_inverse: inherit the independently validated positive dense-potential K1 capacity result as the upper information reference
blocking_references.fit_mean_and_potential_coordinate_cgls1: inherit the frozen v186.1 controls without retuning

evaluation.physical_k1_rule: one unmodified identity-preconditioned physical CGLS step from the supplied field using the exact current residual and denominator floor 1e-30
evaluation.subset_rule: reuse the immutable minimal_shared_gram_ridge five-camera subset frozen before p22 truth was opened

cost_ledger.geometry_cache: 26 dense 1009x1144 response-feature matrices and their setup-local SVD factors are required; this diagnostic does not establish compact storage, wall time, or whole-pipeline RSS
cost_ledger.resource_claim: none before a separately frozen compact factorization, complete-trajectory matched accuracy, fresh-process wall, and whole-pipeline RSS

required_validity_gates: v186.1 protocol, repair, formal, independent validation, decision, source closure, and sealed trees remain unchanged
formal uses only the sealed v186.1 formal response and heldout feature arrays, while independent validation uses only the separately sealed v186.1 independent arrays before comparing outcomes
all 26 response matrices are finite with exact shape 1009x1144 and all heldout features are finite with exact shape 4x1144
each fixed-threshold SVD retains at least one finite positive singular value and reports rank, condition, reconstruction residual, and stationarity without post-result intervention
the prediction API accepts no truth, trajectory, time, power, or size input

physical K1 has no denominator breakdown
formal and parent trees remain unchanged
the independent second implementation passes every required comparison

must_independently_rebuild: all 26 setup-local gesvd pseudoinverses, retained ranks, conditions, coordinates, reconstruction residuals, and stationarity
p22 truth fields, calibrations, frozen five-camera selections, exact vector operators, K0 fields, unchanged physical K1 fields, metrics, tails, decisions, and call receipts

decision_order: Any parent, identity, isolation, shape, SVD, rank, stationarity, mutation, permutation, K1, call-ledger, finite, seal, or independent-recomputation failure makes v187 inconclusive.

If geometry-local K0 passes both sensor arms, conclude PASS_GEOMETRY_LOCAL_FEATURE_K0_CAPACITY_V187 and attribute v186.1 failure to the shared cross-geometry approximation rather than the frozen feature map.

If K0 fails but geometry-local K1 passes both sensor arms, conclude PASS_GEOMETRY_LOCAL_FEATURE_K1_CAPACITY_V187 and attribute v186.1 failure to the shared cross-geometry approximation after preserving one-step refinement.

If neither K0 nor K1 passes both sensor arms, conclude FAIL_GEOMETRY_LOCAL_FEATURE_CAPACITY_V187 and close the DCT12 plus reported-ray Plucker pooled feature map itself for this detector-potential affine inverse.
A passing v187 result authorizes only a separately frozen compact geometry-conditioned factorization diagnostic; it does not authorize neural training or resource claims.

No v187 outcome is a deployable compact algorithm, exact-call reduction, wall/RSS benefit, fresh generalization, neural-operator advantage, curved-ray validation, real BOST, paper success, or algorithm breakthrough.
